checks.explanation: The opposite occurred: China added roughly 8x more power generation capacity than the US in 2025 alone (China's installed capacity grew 16.1% year-over-year vs. the US's projected 1.1% growth in 2026), and China's total installed capacity now exceeds the combined total of the US, EU, India, Japan, and Russia.

sources.title: China Adds Power 8x More Than the US in 2025

checks.explanation: US auto production is trending the opposite direction: 2025 production fell 2% to roughly 10 million light vehicles (well below the historical peak of roughly 12.8 million), and forecasts call for continued flat-to-declining output in 2026-2027, not a new all-time production record.

sources.title: U.S. Auto Manufacturing in 2026: Trends, Challenges & Outlook
